base_declaration.mechanism_rationale: Replace only the public optimizer step rule. Fixed current BCAP relativistic loss, b_cap coefficient 1, zero interventions and noise, and constant schedule; task-owned auxiliary objectives remain active. This card is a reusable technique, not a task-specific optimizer.
